findings.message: Visual-only riverbank props must terrain-ground independently of collision and be tested against the imported terrain height and swim channel.
Visual gate remains open: water, foreground lawn, and mixed toy-scale assets do not yet deliver the required natural opening composition.
Use a session/generation token and exact adapter reference so stale collision probes cannot disable a later session's safety floor.
The compact menu should not compete visually with world discovery; inspect the full first frame, not hotbar slots alone.
